_comment: Public ATS board tokens to poll. Replace with the companies you care about. These are public careers endpoints and are the most stable data source.
_teamtailor_comment: Teamtailor needs a per-company API token, e.g. {"token": "acme", "api_token": "...", "api_version": "20240404"}. Entries without api_token are skipped.
_jazzhr_comment: JazzHR needs an account API key, e.g. {"api_key": "...", "board": "acme.applytojob.com"}. Entries without api_key are skipped.
_jobvite_comment: Jobvite Job Feed needs a paid key+secret, e.g. {"api": "...", "sc": "...", "site": "career-site-name"}. Entries without api/sc are skipped.
